properties.text: Courtside runs the bookings of a community sports hall with four badminton courts and two tennis courts. Members reserve a court for one slot, pay for it, and join a waitlist when the slot they want is taken. Front-desk staff can override most rules when someone turns up with a problem.
properties.title: Purpose

properties.text:
- **Member:** a person with an account. Staff are members with a role.
- **Court:** one playing surface (badminton or tennis, indoor or outdoor).
- **Slot:** one hour on one court, starting on the hour.
- **Booking:** a member's claim on one slot, from held, to confirmed, to cancelled.
- **Waitlist:** members waiting for a slot that is taken. The oldest entry is offered the slot first.
- **Desk:** the front-desk staff role, with the override powers of [SPEC-03 §5](SPEC-03-booking-rules.md#5-desk-overrides).
properties.title: Glossary

properties.text: Members book from their phones. Desk staff work from one shared tablet. The hall manager (admin) reads the reports of [SPEC-06](SPEC-06-reports-and-audit.md).
properties.title: Users

properties.text:
| Spec | Covers |
|---|---|
| [SPEC-01](SPEC-01-members-and-access.md) | Sign-up, roles, sessions |
| [SPEC-02](SPEC-02-database-schema.md) | Every table |
| [SPEC-03](SPEC-03-booking-rules.md) | Slots, booking, overlap, cancellation, desk overrides |
| [SPEC-04](SPEC-04-payments.md) | Prices, payment, refunds |
| [SPEC-05](SPEC-05-waitlist-and-reminders.md) | Waitlist, promotion, reminders |
| [SPEC-06](SPEC-06-reports-and-audit.md) | Daily report, audit trail |
properties.title: Spec map

properties.text: No coaching schedules, no equipment hire, no membership fees. Courtside only sells court time.
properties.title: Non-goals

properties.text:
These apply everywhere. A rule here beats any other spec, and a conflict is a logged deviation ([DEVIATIONS](../DEVIATIONS.md)).

1. All times are stored in UTC and shown in the hall's time zone.
2. Money is an integer number of cents. There are no floats in price code.
3. Every table has a `uuid` primary key named `id`. Foreign keys are `uuid not null` unless the column says otherwise.
4. A rule that needs the clock takes it as a parameter, so tests can fix it.
5. Every numbered acceptance check becomes a test named after it: `test_spec03_ac2_overlap_is_refused`.
properties.title: Conventions

properties.text: A person signs up with an email address and a name. The email must be unique; a second sign-up with the same address is refused with a clear message. New accounts have the role `member`. The `members` table is defined in [SPEC-02 `members`](SPEC-02-database-schema.md#members).
properties.title: Sign-up

properties.text:
| Role | Can |
|---|---|
| member | Book, cancel and pay for their own bookings; see only their own account |
| desk | Everything a member can, for any member, plus the overrides of [SPEC-03 §5](SPEC-03-booking-rules.md#5-desk-overrides) |
| admin | Everything, plus the reports of [SPEC-06](SPEC-06-reports-and-audit.md) |

Roles are set by an admin. There is no self-service upgrade.
properties.title: Roles

properties.text: A session is a signed token. It expires after eight hours. The token carries the member id and the role, and nothing else.
properties.title: Sessions

properties.text:
1. A new member can sign up; signing up again with the same email is refused.
2. A member can read only their own account; a desk user can read any account.
3. A session older than eight hours is rejected.

properties.text:
1. Every foreign-key column is indexed.
2. Two bookings of one court never overlap in time, unless one of them is cancelled.
3. A member who has bookings cannot be deleted.
properties.title: Acceptance checks

properties.text: Every foreign-key column is indexed.
Two bookings of one court never overlap in time, unless one of them is cancelled.
A member who has bookings cannot be deleted.

properties.name: captured_at
properties.notes: null until the money is taken

properties.text:
A slot is one hour, starting on the hour. A court can be booked only inside its opening hours, which are kept per court in [SPEC-02 `opening_hours`](SPEC-02-database-schema.md#opening_hours). The slot grid for a day is built in `src/booking/slots.py` from those rows.

> **DEVIATION:** see [D001](../deviations/D001-opening-hours-are-per-court-not-per-hall.md) — opening hours belong to a court, so the grid is built per court.
properties.title: Slots and opening hours

properties.text:
A member picks a court and a slot. The new row in `bookings` starts as `confirmed` when the slot is free (the columns are in [SPEC-02 `bookings`](SPEC-02-database-schema.md#bookings)). A member holds at most three future bookings. The member, the court and the start and end times are required; the price is worked out by [SPEC-04 §1](SPEC-04-payments.md#1-prices).

> **DEVIATION:** see [D002](../deviations/D002-bookings-store-an-end-time-not-a-duration.md) — a booking stores `ends_at`, not a duration.
properties.title: Making a booking

properties.text: Two bookings of one court never overlap in time. The check runs in the same transaction as the insert, so two members racing for one slot cannot both win: the second gets a refusal that names the next free slot. Cancelled bookings do not count. The rule lives in `src/booking/overlap.py`.
properties.title: Overlap rule

properties.text:
A member cancels a booking until two hours before it starts. A cancelled booking is deleted from `bookings` and its slot is free again. Cancellation triggers the waitlist promotion of [SPEC-05 §2](SPEC-05-waitlist-and-reminders.md#2-promotion).

> **DEVIATION:** see [D003](../deviations/D003-cancelled-bookings-are-kept-with-cancelled-at.md) — the row is kept and stamped, not deleted.
properties.title: Cancellation

properties.text: Desk staff can book inside the two-hour cut-off, cancel any booking, and move a booking to another slot. Every override is written to the audit trail of [SPEC-06 §2](SPEC-06-reports-and-audit.md#2-audit-trail). Overrides never skip the overlap rule of §3.
properties.title: Desk overrides

properties.text:
1. Slots are one hour long, start on the hour and fall inside the court's opening hours.
2. A booking that overlaps an existing one on the same court is refused.
3. A member cannot hold more than three future bookings.
4. A cancelled booking frees its slot.
properties.title: Acceptance checks

properties.text: Slots are one hour long, start on the hour and fall inside the court's opening hours.
A booking that overlaps an existing one on the same court is refused.
A member cannot hold more than three future bookings.
A cancelled booking frees its slot.

The price of a booking is the hourly rate of the court's surface times the hours booked, in cents. Rates live in `src/payments/prices.py`; members see the price before they confirm. A booking has exactly one price, fixed when the booking is made, so a later rate change never alters it ([SPEC-02 `bookings`](SPEC-02-database-schema.md#bookings)).
properties.title: Prices

properties.text:
A confirmed booking is paid online when it is made. The result is one row in `payments` with the amount and `captured_at` ([SPEC-02 `payments`](SPEC-02-database-schema.md#payments)). Payment is recorded once per booking; a second attempt returns the first row.

> **DEVIATION:** see [D005](../deviations/D005-payment-is-taken-at-check-in.md) — the desk takes payment at check-in, not online.
properties.title: Taking payment

properties.text:
Cancelling a paid booking refunds the full amount when the cancellation is more than 24 hours ahead. A refund row records the amount and a reason ([SPEC-02 `refunds`](SPEC-02-database-schema.md#refunds)). A refund never exceeds the amount paid.

> **DEVIATION:** see [D004](../deviations/D004-late-refunds-are-partial.md) — a cancellation inside 24 hours is refunded half.
properties.title: Refunds

properties.text:
1. The price of a booking comes from the court's surface rate.
2. Paying a booking twice records one payment.
3. A refund never exceeds the amount paid.
properties.title: Acceptance checks

properties.text: The price of a booking comes from the court's surface rate.
Paying a booking twice records one payment.
A refund never exceeds the amount paid.

A member can join the waitlist for a court and start time only when that slot is taken. There is one row in `waitlist_entries` per member and slot ([SPEC-02 `waitlist_entries`](SPEC-02-database-schema.md#waitlist_entries)). Joining a free slot is refused: the member should just book it.
properties.title: Joining the waitlist

properties.text:
When a booking is cancelled, the oldest waiting entry for that court and start time is promoted: a new `bookings` row is created for that member and the entry stores its id in `promoted_booking_id`. The member is told by message.

> **DEVIATION:** see [D006](../deviations/D006-a-promoted-waitlist-entry-holds-the-slot-for-15-minutes.md) — the promoted booking is `held` for 15 minutes until the member confirms.
properties.title: Promotion

properties.text: Every confirmed booking gets a reminder 24 hours before it starts: one row in `reminders` with `send_at` ([SPEC-02 `reminders`](SPEC-02-database-schema.md#reminders)). The row is removed when the booking is cancelled, and nothing is sent for a cancelled booking.
properties.title: Reminders

properties.text:
1. A member cannot join the waitlist for a slot that is free.
2. Cancelling a booking promotes the oldest waiting entry for that slot.
3. A reminder is created for a confirmed booking and dropped when it is cancelled.
properties.title: Acceptance checks

properties.text: A member cannot join the waitlist for a slot that is free.
Cancelling a booking promotes the oldest waiting entry for that slot.
A reminder is created for a confirmed booking and dropped when it is cancelled.

The admin sees, for one day, the confirmed `bookings` per court and the money taken in `payments`. Utilisation is booked hours divided by opening hours. The report reads the tables directly and never writes ([SPEC-02 `bookings`](SPEC-02-database-schema.md#bookings)).
properties.title: Daily usage report

properties.text: Every cancellation and every desk override is recorded with who did it, when, and which booking it touched. The trail is append-only and is read by admins only ([SPEC-01 §2](SPEC-01-members-and-access.md#2-roles)).
properties.title: Audit trail

properties.text:
1. The daily report counts only confirmed bookings, per court.
2. Every cancellation and desk override appears in the audit trail.
properties.title: Acceptance checks

Every cancellation and desk override appears in the audit trail.

properties.consequences: `opening_hours` gains a `court_id` column. The slot grid is built per court.
properties.implementation_does: Each court has its own rows in `opening_hours`, one per weekday. The two outdoor tennis courts close at dusk, so a single hall-wide row could not describe them.
properties.spec_says: The hall has one set of opening hours per weekday, shared by every court.
properties.title: Opening hours are per court, not per hall
properties.why: The groundsman closes the outdoor courts in winter while the sports hall stays open.

properties.consequences: The `duration_minutes` column is replaced by `ends_at`. Reports compute durations by subtraction.
properties.implementation_does: A booking has `starts_at` and `ends_at`. The overlap rule compares two intervals directly, and a duration would have to be added to every start before comparing.
properties.spec_says: A booking has a start time and a duration in minutes.
properties.title: Bookings store an end time, not a duration
properties.why: Overlap is the hot path. Comparing stored end times keeps it one indexed range query.

properties.consequences: Every query that counts bookings must filter on status. SPEC-03 §4 still says delete until the spec is rewritten.
properties.implementation_does: The row stays. Its status becomes `cancelled` and `cancelled_at` is set. The overlap rule ignores cancelled rows, so the slot is still free.
properties.spec_says: A cancelled booking is deleted from `bookings` and its slot is free again.
properties.title: Cancelled bookings are kept with cancelled_at
properties.why: Refunds ([SPEC-04 §3](../specs/SPEC-04-payments.md#3-refunds)) and the audit trail ([SPEC-06 §2](../specs/SPEC-06-reports-and-audit.md#2-audit-trail)) need the booking to point at.

properties.consequences: The `reason` of a refund row says `late` for the half refund. SPEC-04 §3 needs a rewrite.
properties.implementation_does: A cancellation inside 24 hours of the start refunds half the amount paid. A cancellation more than 24 hours ahead still refunds all of it.
properties.spec_says: Cancelling a paid booking refunds the full amount.
properties.title: Late refunds are partial
properties.why: The desk could not resell last-minute slots, and the hall asked for a late-cancellation fee.

properties.consequences: Reports cannot assume a confirmed booking has a payment. SPEC-04 §2 needs a rewrite.
properties.implementation_does: The desk takes payment when the member arrives. A booking is `confirmed` before its `payments` row exists, and the row is created with `captured_at` at check-in.
properties.spec_says: A confirmed booking is paid online when it is made.
properties.title: Payment is taken at check-in
properties.why: Most members pay in cash, and the online provider was not ready for the launch.

properties.consequences: `held` becomes a booking status and the overlap rule counts held bookings. A job must expire them.
properties.implementation_does: Promotion creates a booking with status `held`. The member has 15 minutes to confirm; after that the slot goes to the next entry.
properties.spec_says: Promotion creates a confirmed booking for the oldest waiting member.
properties.title: A promoted waitlist entry holds the slot for 15 minutes
properties.why: Members who were offered a slot at night never saw it, and the slot stayed blocked.
